name: io.github.strangeadvancedmarketing/adam-framework
description: MCP server that exposes Adam Framework vault memory as searchable tools for Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, or any MCP-compatible client. Gives your AI persistent memory across sessions by reading from a local vault of markdown files. Works with any markdown folder including Obsidian vaults.

environmentVariables.name: ADAM_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to your vault directory containing markdown memory files. Default: ~/AdamsVault/workspace
